_instructions: Copy this file to exams/<exam-id>/exam_config.json and fill in every field. Remove all _instructions and _note fields before running the engine. See engine/config.schema.json for the full schema and docs/HOW_TO_ADD_AN_EXAM.md for guidance.
_note_skill_taxonomy: Define one entry per skill. Use H1 (or equivalent) for the cognitive load dimension if your exam has one. All other entries are evaluable skills.
_note_macro_areas: Group skills into broad assessment domains. Each 'skills' array lists skill IDs that belong to this domain.
_note_segments: Set target item counts for each segment. Only 'training' requires explanation_layer: true.
_note_explanation_rules: These rules govern generation AND validation. correct_line1_pattern is a regex string applied as new RegExp(...). Prefixes are the literal strings required at the start of each line.
_note_explanation_fallbacks: One entry per skill ID. Used when the item's justification fields are too short. All four fields required per skill.

H2.correct_line1: REPLACE — fallback explanation_correct line 1 for this skill.
H2.correct_line2: REPLACE — fallback explanation_correct line 2 for this skill.
H2.error: REPLACE — fallback error description (without prefix) for this skill.
H2.correction: REPLACE — fallback correction text (without prefix) for this skill.
